_comment: VaultMCP stack knowledge base. Edit freely — roles map asset titles (lowercase substring match) to production roles; 'exclusive' roles conflict when two assets fill them; 'requires' declares prerequisites; 'recipes' are curated stacks resolved against your own library.

requires.reason: Trax is a MicroSplat module and needs the core MicroSplat terrain shader.
HDRP pathway is a MicroSplat module and needs the core shader.
URP pathway is a MicroSplat module and needs the core shader.
StampIT stamps are consumed by MicroVerse or applied via MicroSplat.
Additional weather packs extend the core Enviro system.
Dynamic Nature packs utilize NatureManufacture shaders or procedural terrain blending.

recipes.name: Photorealistic outdoor biome (Unity HDRP)
recipes.notes: Non-destructive terrain authoring (MicroVerse) -> procedural texturing (MicroSplat) -> unified material BRDF across kitbashed vendors (Better Lit/Shaders) -> ray-traced GI (HTrace) -> dynamic sky/weather -> physics water.

recipes.name: Stylized open world (Unity URP)
recipes.notes: Performance-first stack: GPU-instanced vegetation and lighter post-processing for URP targets.
